image_description: An outdoor scene at a rustic lumber processing site. A man in a white t-shirt and cap stands on the right holding a piece of wood. To the left is a covered shed structure housing a large, complex mechanical sawmill apparatus with gears and belts. Stacks of rough-hewn logs are visible behind the machinery. The ground is dirt and gravel. Background shows green vegetation.
